name: AverageDowntimeChart
description: Stacked bar chart of average downtime (curtailment vs operational issues). Wraps `ChartContainer` and `BarChart`; pass period labels and rate arrays via `data`

props.name: title
props.description: Chart title (unit renders on its own line below)

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message when there are no period labels or rate series

props.name: yTicksFormatter
props.description: Formats Y-axis ticks, tooltips, and bar data labels (values are 0–1 rates). Defaults to rate × 100 via `formatNumber`

fields.name: labels
fields.description: X-axis period labels, one per bar; empty renders the empty state

fields.name: curtailment
fields.description: "Curtailment" downtime rate per period, as a fraction (0–1), aligned to `labels`

fields.name: operationalIssues
fields.description: "Op. Issues" downtime rate per period, as a fraction (0–1), stacked on `curtailment`
